pr_title: Implement ADR 0110 humanoid profiles and motion
pr_body: Implements ADR 0110 in staged patches. This request adds persisted model-owned humanoid profile metadata, portable humanoid semantics, structural validation and conservative import detection, Native-to-Humanoid model-space delta conversion, target-bound Humanoid baking, root-motion metadata without implicit proportion scaling, and Derived Cache keying. Follow-up requests on the same Draft PR wire imported Humanoid variants, Animation Set Auto/Native/Humanoid sources, editor configuration, target resolution, and packaging.
